evals.name: registration-write
evals.prompt: Implement the write side of the feature that adds an author to an open list.
evals.expected_output: Typed command with returned event beside its feature.
assertions: Its public Handle returns AuthorRegistered with Name.
Does not append the event manually.

evals.name: registration-list
evals.prompt: Wire the new Authors dialog and list to the registered backend feature.
evals.expected_output: Bind the write and observed read contracts independently.
assertions: Uses a generated command for the dialog.
Maps AuthorRegistered onto Author and binds the Authors DataPage to the generated AllAuthors query.
Does not insert a second local copy of the new row.

evals.name: registration-journey
evals.prompt: Demonstrate that registration actually updates the authors screen.
evals.expected_output: Run the visible journey including refusal.
assertions: Lets AddAuthor create the ID and submits Aster in a fresh namespace.
Checks live arrival before reloading, then checks the same AllAuthors ID after reload.
Runs the empty-name CommandScenario.Execute check separately and expects no append.
